caption: The drawing features a wooden table with an oval shape at the ends and a rectangular central surface, depicted in brown tones suggesting a polished wood finish. The table stands on four slender, turned legs, each leg ending in a small caster wheel. Below the tabletop, there are two central drawers with round metal knobs, horizontally aligned. The area beneath the drawers, enclosed by the semicircular ends of the table, is covered by a vertically pleated fabric skirt in beige and brown hues. The background is a uniform light beige color, with no additional objects present. The entire composition is centered, and the table is shown in full view from the front.
title: Sheraton Mahogany Sewing Table
